verdict.rationale: ELSTER exposes a software channel that third-party tax software uses to transmit filings, so a question about versioned APIs is a fair one for this product. However, the evidence pack never mentions API versioning, release cadence, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The only developer-facing items show that any ELSTER-supporting software can transmit, and that the ERiC artifact host timed out on a single probe; neither speaks to versioning or deprecation.
